description.zh: API编号，系统生成，全局唯一
description.en: The ID of the API. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

description.zh: 指定要操作的app编号，支持输入多个，“,”分隔，最多支持100个
description.en: The IDs of applications. Separate multiple application IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 applications IDs can be entered.

description.zh: API分组ID，系统生成，全局唯一
description.en: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

- **RELEASE**

- **TEST**

title.zh: 撤销多个APP对指定API的访问权限

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向API提供者和API使用者
- 撤销前请查看添加授权记录的授权者，API所有者只能撤销Provider的授权，API使用者只能撤销Consumer的授权
descriptions.en:
- This operation is intended for API providers and callers.

- Before you revoke access permissions, check by whom the permissions were granted. API providers can only revoke permissions granted by a Provider, and API callers can only revoke permissions granted by a Consumer.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi remove-apps-authorities --group-id 523e8dc7bbe04613b5b1d726c2a7889d --api-id baacc592e63a4cb6a41920d9d3f91f38 --stage-name TEST --app-ids 2386789,3286798 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi RemoveAppsAuthorities --region cn-hangzhou --StageName TEST --ApiId baacc592e63a4cb6a41920d9d3f91f38 --AppIds '2386789,3286798' --GroupId 523e8dc7bbe04613b5b1d726c2a7889d
